name: Outdoor Wood Furniture Inc.
old_description: Swing-Mate Buddy For Heavy Over Sized Swing Beds Or Porch Swings
about:
Outdoor Wood Furniture Inc. was founded in 1993 in West Columbia, South Carolina. The company operates under the name Outdoor Wood Inc. and has been selling outdoor and lifestyle products online since its inception.

The company functions as an e-commerce retailer, offering a broad assortment of goods from various brands. Its catalog includes porch swing hardware such as chains, springs, and ceiling hooks from brands like Levi Innovations and Perfection; baby swaddle blankets from Applesauce; Christmas ornaments from Kurt Adler and Ganz; automotive air fresheners from Scent South; and graphic t-shirts. The business does not appear to manufacture its own products but instead curates and resells items sourced from multiple suppliers.

Outdoor Wood Furniture Inc. serves individual consumers through its website, shipping products across categories that span outdoor living, home decor, baby care, seasonal gifting, automotive accessories, and apparel. There is no indication in the available information of a dedicated B2B or wholesale channel.

The company’s website emphasizes its longevity with the tagline “Sporty stuff for outdoor people. Since 1993!” but does not articulate a specific founding mission or competitive differentiation beyond its product selection.
